description: List the canonical portfolio case studies (17 entries). Optional filters combine with AND and match case-insensitively; unknown values yield an empty list. Each project includes ownership (Lead owner, Contributor, Team delivery) and builtBy (solo, team). Frontend Mentor Lab is one entry archiving 21 nested practice challenges — do not count it as 21 flagship projects. Tags are Title Case display strings like "AI Workflow", "Next.js"; matching is case-insensitive so "web3" matches "Web3".
name: list_projects
